description: Playwright MCP server — browser automation for AI agents (navigate, click, type, screenshot, UI review) via structured accessibility snapshots. Installs the npm package '@playwright/mcp'; the command is 'playwright-mcp'.
notes: playwright-mcp is an MCP server: your AI tool launches it on demand over stdio, so you do NOT run it standalone or set it to auto-start.
Register it in your AI tool's MCP config:
Claude Code: claude mcp add playwright -- playwright-mcp

Browser: defaults to your installed Google Chrome. To use a Playwright-managed browser instead, run 'playwright-mcp install-browser chromium' (downloads to %LOCALAPPDATA%\ms-playwright, shared with any other Playwright on this machine) and pass '--browser chromium'.
Useful flags: --headless, --browser <chrome|chromium|firefox|webkit|msedge>, --isolated, --device "iPhone 15". Run 'playwright-mcp --help' for the full list.
pre_install: # some npm install scripts shell out to bare 'node'; this bucket keeps Node.js off PATH, so put it there for this process only
# npm also runs the package's own 'prepare' script, which can fail on a devDependency we deliberately skipped - what matters is that the dependencies landed
